meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and did anyone hear him first?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. On what basis did you enter it?

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
Turn the screen, Hale. I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. People write in other places and paste it in, so what else do you have?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
Give it here; I'll search it myself. Students misremember lines, Hale, that's not a verdict. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Your room, before classes, not in front of anyone in his class. I want that and the promise that nothing goes on his file in an email to me tonight, cc the principal. Is anything on his record right now, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You offered a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing going on Owen's record. I still require written confirmation that the rewrite stays private and away from his class, that nothing is on his record now, and that nothing will be placed there. I expect that confirmation in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Last position, accepting a private supervised rewrite in Hale's room before classes, while still wanting written confirmation tonight that nothing is on Owen's record now or will be.
What moved her: Hale showed the version history with exact times and then a misattributed Hamlet line she could search herself, which gave her specific, dated, checkable evidence tied to Owen's own essay.
What cost ground: Nothing; Hale owned the early zero in one sentence, kept to documents, and never attacked Owen or leaned on the detector.
Try next time: When offering the rewrite, state right away that nothing is on Owen's record now and that you will confirm the terms in writing, so her last open question is answered before she has to ask it.
